love.summary: Most readers sense a meaningful romantic connection or emotional turning point on the horizon for Capricorn, so stay open to deep bonds while remaining mindful of who you allow into your personal space.
love.disagreement: One reading cautioned about toxic individuals in relationships, while others leaned toward hopeful reunion or mutual understanding with no such warning.

finance.summary: Most readers sense a financial turning point this week, with stagnation lifting and new opportunities emerging, so embrace what comes your way while keeping spending measured and decisions steady.
finance.disagreement: Some readers focused on cautious, careful action to protect gains, while others emphasized openness and releasing self-doubt to fully receive incoming abundance.

career.summary: Most readers see a promising professional opportunity on the horizon for Capricorn this week, so pursue it with confidence, follow through consistently, and avoid walking away from your current situation before something better is firmly in place.
career.disagreement: Some readers emphasized caution and securing stability before making moves, while others encouraged bold, passionate pursuit of the incoming opportunity without hesitation.

family.summary: Only a few readers touched on family this week, but those who did suggest that easing tensions and leaning on your support network go hand in hand, so make an effort to understand those around you and let others help lighten your load.

overall_tone_summary: Two hopeful readings edge out the transformative pull, lighting the week with quiet optimism.
